1) Run mc admin info <alias> to identify the offline node, then ping/ssh to confirm the machine is alive; 2) If it is alive, run systemctl status minio and check the logs — the usual causes are OOM, a failed disk mount or an expired certificate; 3) For intra-cluster network failures check networking and security groups: MinIO nodes must reach each other; 4) Once the node is back, run mc admin heal -r <alias> and watch the healing progress.
MinIO 集群有磁盘离线。纠删码依赖足额磁盘，离线盘数量超过校验块数后对象将不: The MinIO cluster has disks offline. Erasure coding needs a full complement of disks — once offline disks exceed the parity count, objects become unreadable and unwritable and data is at risk.
MinIO 集群有节点离线，该节点上的所有磁盘同时退出，冗余度大幅下降，再掉节点: The MinIO cluster has a node offline: every disk on that node left at once, redundancy dropped sharply, and losing one more node would make objects unavailable.
